q2_gaps: intensional / non-veridical object of *require* (likewise need, want, seek): the indefinite-argument rule mints an existential witness, so the parse asserts that a group of large repairs exists, whereas the sentence only says they are required — the instruction set offers no way to record an unasserted object
notes: Roles follow the instruction set as written (a stative transitive subject stays Agent; requiring does not change its object, so Theme; bare simple present takes no status atom), and the descriptive modifier "large" distributes over the group's members with the prescribed 1.0/0.9 rule TV. The bare-plural object could alternatively have taken the bare class symbol `repair`, but that has nowhere to attach "large".
